heading: Accessibility Feature
descriptions: Mapping screens now have colored tiles as well as icons to better reflect the meaning.
tickIconInfo: Tap once to turn the tile green and show a tick icon
questionMarkIconInfo: Tap twice to turn the tile yellow and show a question icon
badImageIconInfo: Tap thrice to turn the tile red and show a bad imagery icon
turnOnOffDescription: Turn on/off the feature by visiting the Settings section under Profile
